arcades.info_text: Trampoline centre with arcade machines. Some arcade machines are in the cafe and some are in a separate dedicated area/alcove. Either way, it's not stated as being necessary to sign up for a trampolining session to access the machines. Having said that, at least one ziv contributor was prevented from accessing the arcade area due to not having a booking and was informed by the manager that you need to either have a booking or be accompanying someone with a booking to be allowed to walk to the area where the arcade machines are located. / Also, if you don't have a booking, you can't access the O2 itself before it officially opens at 10am and therefore can't access the arcade machines. For example on Saturdays, Oxygen Freejumping nominally opens at 9am and the O2 officially opens at 10am. So if you arrive between 9 and 10, you can't get to the arcade area unless you have a trampolining booking, as O2 security will prevent you from entering the O2 itself. (After 10am you won't have this problem.) Because of this, listed the opening time as 10am each day rather than what it says on the Oxygen website. / In addition to the listed games, there are a few sweet machines: / *Chupa Chups...

The PS3 also has a selection of PS2 games (80+) / - There's a back room that has a line-up of classic consoles (from Atari 2600 to Wii) - ask the staff if you want to play a certain game. There is also a small room with a full dedicated Guitar Hero/Rock Band set up! / Right side is all arcade machines! Majority of cabinets are in very good condition and appear to be maintained often.
